This prayer was instantly answered by a sudden severe shower, which quenched the devouring flames.
"First seek the halls of Dis below, Pass deep Avernus' vale, and meet Your father in his own retreat."
Æneas again dutifully obeyed; but when Venus saw him afloat once more, she hastened to Neptune, and bade him watch over her unfortunate son.
